meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: Claude 会先拉取 LazyCodex 与上游 Codex 源码、跑最小复现并确认根因,再判断缺陷属于哪个仓库,产出一份带证据的 GitHub issue(仅 openai/codex 可开 PR)。题目标题、环境、复现步骤、根因、修复建议都在内。
howto.when: 当你要求上报、提交或分流 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 插件等 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 LazyCodex 安装器的报错提成 GitHub issue
say.note: 会先拉源码查根因再建单

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 崩溃在干净上游也能复现,帮我判断该提到哪个仓库
say.note: 会比对两处源码后路由

say.text: openai/codex 的 bug 我已修好,帮我提个 PR
say.note: 只在 openai/codex 允许开 PR

howto.what_en: Claude pulls the LazyCodex and upstream Codex sources, runs a minimal reproduction and confirms the root cause, then routes the defect to the owning repo and files an evidence-backed GitHub issue (PR only for openai/codex).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, omo-codex, or Codex plugin bug.

say_en.text: File the LazyCodex installer error as a GitHub issue
This Codex CLI crash reproduces on clean upstream; which repo?
I already fixed an openai/codex bug; open a PR
